*.scss.jekyll_syntax: The top two lines are Jekyll front matter (---) to indicate SCSS. Absolutely nothing—no whitespace, comments, or code—should ever appear before these lines. They must be lines 1 and 2 of the file.
*.scss.organization: Styles are ordered from top to bottom, matching the order of elements as rendered in the respective html
*.scss.media_queries: After the main CSS, there are blocks of media queries handling the same CSS from largest screen width to smallest. Whenever adding CSS to the top section, add corresponding adjustments to the media query sections for final tweaks based on screen width.
